subject: AML Health — AWS private offer renewal & evidence sprint
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <m.singh@amlhealth.com>, Andrew Cole <procurement@amlhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 16:14:00 -0700
Subject: AML Health — AWS private offer renewal & evidence sprint

Hi Maya / Andrew —

Thanks again for the call today. Per our conversation, AML Health is scheduled to renew the AWS private offer on 2027-06-01 and you indicated the acceptance window requires SOC2 evidence and a finalized PO in AWS Marketplace by mid-May to meet procurement cutoffs. To keep things moving, here's what Redwood needs from you this week: 
- SOC2 Type II confirmation (PDF) or equivalently scoped audit report
- Confirmed billing entity and PO reference to appear on the private offer
- Any special invoicing attributes (VAT/Tax ID) or fiscal contact

I've looped in Marissa (contracts) and Tessa (onboarding) to coordinate the acceptance checklist and DocuSign routing. Attached: private-offer-acceptance-checklist.xlsx (stub) and a blank PO template.

If you can send the SOC2 and confirm billing details by Wed (2027-04-28) we'll draft the private offer and circulate a DocuSign for signature the following week.

Thanks —
Jordan
Principal Cloud Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: private-offer-acceptance-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12KB), AML-PO-Draft-Redwood.docx (docx, 18KB)

From: Maya Singh <m.singh@amlhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Andrew Cole <procurement@amlhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AML Health — AWS private offer renewal & evidence sprint

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for the clear summary. We're aligned on timeline but a couple of clarifications from procurement/compliance: 
1) SOC2: we can provide the SOC2 Type II PDF (we'll send redacted if needed) by EOD Tue (2027-04-27).
2) Billing entity: billing should be "AML Health, Inc." with Tax ID 12-3456789. Procurement wants the PO to reference contract RDW-AML-2027 and the cost center code 44-17.
3) Invoicing cadence: monthly invoices to be sent to invoices@amlhealth.com with Andrew CC'd.

A question: does Redwood support staggered acceptance (split acceptance) if our CFO requests a 3-month phased activation for budget smoothing? That would affect the private offer line items.

Attaching SOC2 stub for reference.

Best,
Maya Singh
Head of Compliance, AML Health

Attachments: SOC2-TypeII-AML-2026.pdf (pdf, 2.1MB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 11:36:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: AML Health — AWS private offer renewal & evidence sprint

Folks — forwarding the SOC2 and procurement notes from AML Health. Action items for us: 
- Marissa: I'll own the PO drafting and ensure the private offer references RDW-AML-2027 + cost center. Need legal to confirm no custom SOW required.
- Tessa: prepare onboarding plan for a potential phased activation (3-mo staircase) and provide SLA implications; include estimated token overage mitigation for first 90 days.
- Kimberly: confirm billing VAT/tax handling and whether AWS Marketplace supports the invoicing split they requested.

I'll draft the private offer with a primary full-activation SKU and an alternate "staggered activation" SKU mapping to their request. If procurement wants phased billing, we can set Milestone lines but must get AWS Marketplace acceptance for split-PO.

I'll aim to have a PO draft and DocuSign-ready package by Fri (2027-04-30).

Marissa Cole
Sr. Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: AML-PO-Draft-Redwood.docx (docx, 18KB)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <m.singh@amlhealth.com>, Andrew Cole <procurement@amlhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AML Health — AWS private offer renewal & evidence sprint

Maya / Andrew —

Appreciate the quick turnaround on SOC2 and the billing details. Next steps and commitments from Redwood: 
1) Marissa will circulate the PO (DocuSign link included below) by EOD. That PO will include the main full-activation line and an alternate staggered-activation line with clear acceptance criteria.
2) Tessa will send a 90-day onboarding playbook and a short SLA note specifying latency targets for the phased activation.
3) Kimberly will confirm invoicing flow with Marketplace and whether split acceptance will require AWS support ticket (we'll open one if needed).

If AML Health is good to receive the DocuSign now, we can aim for signature next Tue (2027-05-04) which keeps the private offer assembly and AWS acceptance on track for mid-May.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/AUTH/AML-RDW-PO
Confluence checklist: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/AML-Health-Renewal-Checklist

Thanks everyone — I'll watch for the signed PO and confirm when the private offer is submitted to AWS.

Jordan
Principal Cloud Sales
Redwood Inference
